text:
Jordan (SRE): Hi team — accepted the org invite but when I try to open a PR from my fork I get a 403 and GitHub says I need to verify my email. I thought SSO did everything automatically. Anyone seen this?
Lina (People Ops): Welcome Jordan! SSO links accounts, but GitHub still requires that the email on the account be verified before org membership is fully active. Which email did the invite go to (work or personal)?
Jordan (SRE): The invite went to jordan+work@redwood.ai but my GH account primary email is jordan.dev@gmail.com. The invite acceptance seems to have been applied to my personal account earlier (old habit).
Mark (Platform): That mismatch will block team mapping. Quick options: 1) verify and make the work email primary on the GH account you actually want to use, 2) or tell People Ops which username to re-invite. Also check https://github.com/settings/emails to confirm verification status.
Jordan (SRE): I added and verified the work email but membership state still shows "Pending" and PR creation from fork gets blocked with: 
```
You must verify your email address before you can create pull requests in this organization.
```
Lina (People Ops): Hmm, I see an older pending invite for username jordan_old that was accepted previously and is conflicting. I'll revoke the old invite and re-send directly to the GH username you want (jordan-sre). That usually clears the stale mapping.
github-bot: audit: revoked invite for user jordan_old (id: inv-4321).
Lina (People Ops): Re-invited to jordan-sre now — please accept and then re-authorize SSO: https://github.com/organizations/redwood-inference/account_authorizations/new
Jordan (SRE): Accepted the new invite and re-authorized SSO. Trying the PR flow again... works! PR created from fork and branch. Thanks for the fast help. :thumbsup:
Mark (Platform): Great — leaving a note for the onboarding checklist: "If PRs from forks are blocked, verify work email is primary and look for stale accepted invites on alternate usernames."
Jordan (SRE): Happy to test the checklist update. Closing thread. :tada:
